{{Quote|Good work. Processing this information shows that this may be some kind of lab, but large chunks of data are missing. I need you to extract information from the leaders' computers, by any means necessary.|Lieutenant Joth, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Rond Fenimer''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked in a [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] as an [[Administrator/Legends|administrative head]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He, and two other executives, [[Benn Calder]] and [[Pirt Rawklin]], were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]], when it became apparent that the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] was involved in some form of illicit activity. Upon being killed, the spacer employed by Lieutenant Joth collected Fenimer's passcode and used it to download information from his personal [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. Upon doing so, it was discovered that the laboratory was indeed involved in unsanctioned [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] projects.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It's a lab, all right. It's being used to bio-engineer creatures. This may be sanctioned for some labs, but this one is operating under the radar. This means trouble. Shut the place down.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] by the name of Rond Fenimer worked as an [[Administrator/Legends|administrative head]] on an island [[Illegal Lab (Corellia)|laboratory]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Fenimer, and two other executives by the name of [[Benn Calder]] and [[Pirt Rawklin]], oversaw the work of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maldien]], and the other [[Scientist/Legends|researchers]] and [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] who operated within the [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]].<ref name="SWG" /> Meanwhile, in the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Joth]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] became aware of rumors that the laboratory was involved in some form of illicit activity.<ref name="SWG:CMTDR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Coronet Murmurs: Tracking Down Rumors|Corellia}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Eager to learn more, Joth employed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to investigate the laboratory, and uncover more information. In the process of doing so, Joth instructed the spacer to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Fenimer and the two other administrative heads. Despite putting up a fight with his small arsenal of [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]], Fenimer was killed, and the spacer collected from his body a passcode which was used to access and download information from his office [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. The information gleaned from the computer confirmed Lieutenant Joth's suspicions that the laboratory was being used for unsanctioned [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] projects on various [[Species/Legends|creatures]]. In light of this, Joth ordered the spacer to shut down the facility.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
During his time as an administrative head in the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] laboratory, Rond Fenimer wore a long beige and [[Color/Legends|brown-colored]] [[holiday]] [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], over top a white and brown-colored muscle [[shirt]]. His other [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] consisted of a pair of light brown comfortable slacks and a pair of black dress shoes. His personal arsenal consisted of multiple types of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]] and [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], including a [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|D-18 pistol]], an [[FWG-5 Flechette Smart Pistol]], a [[Striker projectile pistol]], and an [[SE-14 blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rond Fenimer was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rond Fenimer was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> In the game, one of the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]], titled "[[W:c:swg:Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction|Coronet Murmurs: Agents of Destruction]]," featured Rond Fenimer. The objective of the quest was for players to kill Benn Calder, Pirt Rawklin, and Rond Fenimer for their passcodes, which could be used to proceed to the next quest objective.<ref name="SWG" />
